description: A meal service company delivers meals to customers either on electric bikes or scooters. A bike can hold 8 meals and requires 3 units of charge. A scooter can hold 5 meals and requires 2 units of charge. Since the city is more friendly towards scooters, at most 30% of the electric vehicles can be bikes and at least 20 scooters must be used. If the company only has 200 units of charge available, how many of each vehicle should be used to maximize the number of meals that can be delivered?

BikeCapacity.definition: Number of meals a bike can hold

BikeCharge.definition: Units of charge a bike requires

ScooterCapacity.definition: Number of meals a scooter can hold

ScooterCharge.definition: Units of charge a scooter requires

MaxBikeFraction.definition: Maximum fraction of electric vehicles that can be bikes

MinScooters.definition: Minimum number of scooters to be used

objective.description: "Maximize the total number of meals delivered by choosing the optimal number of bikes and scooters."

constraints.description: (number of scooters) >= 20 and is an integer
(number of bikes) is a non-negative integer

numBikes.definition: Number of bikes used for delivery

numScooters.definition: Number of scooters used for delivery
